acceptanceCriteria.summary: Authorized GM creates a fully version-bound Encounter draft.
All selections use governed stable IDs and receipts.
Placements and overrides never mutate source or live state.
Every command reauthorizes role, scope, visibility, entitlement, pack, and versions.
Dependencies, scale, exclusivity, actions, resources, and combinations validate before attachment.
Pressure outputs expose inputs, assumptions, evidence, uncertainty, omissions, and policy version.
No balanced, fair, safe, winnable, optimal, or guaranteed label is permitted.
Analysis preserves independent pressure dimensions.
Incomplete and contradictory data lowers confidence and warns.
Bounded simulations are deterministic, advisory, and nonmutating.
Scenario comparison records explicit deltas and immutable snapshots.
Player and observer projections do not leak hidden encounter information.
Approved snapshots attach without mutating launch snapshots or Sessions.
Concurrency, ambiguity, reconnect, and revocation preserve state without duplication.
Offline use remains read/local-draft only.
Warnings and estimates are accessibly equivalent across form factors.
Diagnostics exclude hidden and private content by default.
Authorized exports preserve identity, evidence, warnings, uncertainty, and receipts.
Core operation requires no AI, paid service, production credentials, or external telemetry.
Deterministic fixtures and blocking tests cover valid and failure paths.

implementationBoundary: Design complete; implementation remains dependency-gated by the active P9-06 sequence and does not authorize guaranteed-balance claims, paid simulation, production credentials, real-user data collection, internal-alpha release, production deployment, or public release.
